binding_account: Keeping is shared by the hour and handed on, and keepers check the canvas and the intended form before they repair (P05 add-step 21 of 96); help between rooms flows from a room whose own work is safe, or repays earlier help, and is refused where a request brings a quarrel (P16 add-condition 19 of 96); where a room in need asks, the record often cannot show the help arriving or its cause (A13 restricted in 33 of 96; of its 33 lines, 12 fail as stated, 14 the record cannot show, 3 both, 4 neither); carrying on begins before the close and on a later canvas returns to the call (P13 add-step 24 of 96; A09 restricted in 16, 11 of its lines fail as stated; P01 link 16, 5 from a later canvas and 5 from damage or a loss). Keeping relates to each of the other two; traded help and carrying on are not related to each other.
